review_processes.name: STATIN FY 2025-26 Year-End Appraisal
review_processes.description: STATIN year-end Employee Performance Management Form for financial year 2025-26. Weighting: 60% measurable performance targets / 40% GoJ core and technical competencies. Bands: Superior 100%, Very Good 91-99%, Good 80-90%, Satisfactory 75-79%, Unsatisfactory below 75% (PIP).

review_processes.name: STATIN FY 2025-26 Coaching Reviews
review_processes.description: STATIN mid-cycle coaching for financial year 2025-26. Policy requires at least three formal performance coaching conversations during the financial year before year-end appraisal.

review_processes.name: STATIN FY 2026-27 Goal Setting and Individual Work Plan
review_processes.description: Agree performance targets and key outputs for FY 2026-27 (EPM Form Sections 1-4). Cascaded from Division/Unit Plans. Weighting guidance: 60% targets / 40% competencies.

trainings.name: STATIN PMS Guidelines for Managers
trainings.description: How to cascade Division and Unit Plans into Individual Work Plans, agree targets and key outputs, and apply the STATIN rating scale and performance bands.

trainings.name: STATIN Performance Coaching
trainings.description: Running the minimum three coaching conversations, documenting evidence, and opening a Performance Improvement Plan when scores fall below 75%.

posts_group.title: Company announcements
posts_group.description: Official announcements for Statistical Institute of Jamaica.

posts.title: STATIN PMS Cycle — Close FY 2025-26 and Open FY 2026-27 IWPs
posts.description: Colleagues, year-end appraisals for FY 2025-26 are open alongside coaching reviews. Managers: agree FY 2026-27 Individual Work Plans (Sections 1-4) cascaded from Division and Unit Plans. Final rating guidance is 60% targets / 40% competencies. Scores below 75% require PIP or development interventions. Contact Human Resources for support.

ui_checklist.weighting: State 60% measurable targets / 40% competencies in the demo (Factorial does not lock the arithmetic).
ui_checklist.bands: Call out Superior / Very Good / Good / Satisfactory / Unsatisfactory (<75% PIP).
ui_checklist.hellen: Hellen Howard = Good ~86% story (embargoed releases sample from PMS guidelines).
ui_checklist.daisy: Daisy Dawson = Unsatisfactory <75% → PIP / training path.
ui_checklist.laura: Laura Lewis = Very Good / Superior → incentive recommendation.
ui_checklist.cascade: Mention Government priorities → Strategic Plan → Division → Unit → Individual Work Plan.
ui_checklist.coaching: Policy requires at least three coaching conversations in the financial year.
ui_checklist.appeal: Employee may accept or wish to appeal; HR grievance process is outside Factorial automation.
ui_checklist.agreements: Initiate FY 2026/27 IWP agreements in UI if API bulk_initiate is blocked.

job_postings.title: STATIN Statistical Officer
job_postings.description: Support production and dissemination of official statistics within Economic and Social Statistics. Apply GoJ core competencies and STATIN technical competencies (Information Management; Communication and Service Delivery). Shortlist matrix pass mark guidance: 70% (occasionally 60%).

job_postings.title: STATIN Field Interviewer (Special Project)
job_postings.description: Contract field interviewer for survey / census-style special projects (Labour Force, Household Surveys, etc.). Temporary project recruitment aligned to Field Services staffing. Requires TRN, NIS and government ID at onboarding.

job_postings.title: STATIN Personnel / Staffing Officer
job_postings.description: Join Human Resources Staffing Unit to coordinate vacancy requests, advertisements, shortlisting, interview packs, IRHC approval routing, and recruitment folders for permanent and project posts.

job_postings.title: STATIN Executive Secretary, ODG
job_postings.description: Support the Office of the Director General with records, embargoed release logistics, and confidential administration. Competitive recruitment with competency-based interview scoring.

candidates.cover_letter: Statistical professional with experience in data production and confidentiality protocols. Eager to contribute to STATIN Economic and Social Statistics.
Experienced field interviewer available for Labour Force and household survey special projects across Jamaica.
HR staffing specialist familiar with public-sector vacancy control, shortlisting matrices and interview administration.
Executive support professional with strong records management and confidentiality practice for directorate-level offices.
